teamSeason.foot: “Ø” marks per-match averages over the complete season. “%” marks cumulative ratios — sum of hits divided by sum of attempts, not the mean of per-match ratios. When a metric is missing in the data, we show “not available” — no fabricated zeros.

matchPreview.foot: Form window: up to five most recent completed matches of the current season. Before season start, the previous season in full. During the World Cup: all qualifying matches of the team up to its first World Cup match, then only World Cup matches. “Ø” marks per-match averages over the window. “%” marks cumulative ratios — sum of hits across all matches divided by sum of attempts, not the mean of per-match ratios. When a metric is missing in the data, we show “not available” — no fabricated zeros.
